{
  "kind": "regex",
  "entity_type": "INSURANCE_POLICY_NUMBER",
  "pattern": "(?<![A-Z0-9-])\\bINS-[A-Z]{2}-\\d{4}-[A-Z]\\b(?![A-Z0-9-])",
  "rationale": "Matches standalone insurance policy numbers with the exact shape INS-AA-0000-A. The surrounding lookarounds prevent matching the valid-looking substring inside SKUs, version strings, or longer hyphenated identifiers.",
  "positive_examples": [
    "INS-AB-1234-C",
    "INS-QT-0001-Z",
    "INS-MN-4820-R",
    "INS-XK-9075-B",
    "INS-PL-1111-A",
    "INS-RD-6502-Y",
    "INS-HJ-3008-K",
    "INS-VW-7744-M"
  ],
  "negative_examples": [
    "INS-AB-123-C",
    "INS-AB-12345-C",
    "INS-AB-1234",
    "INS-ABC-1234-C",
    "INS-ab-1234-c",
    "SKU-INS-AB-1234-C",
    "INS-AB-1234-C-REV2",
    "CLM-2024-123456",
    "INS-AB-12A4-C",
    "INS-AB-1234-CC"
  ],
  "taxonomy_term": {
    "domain": "insurance",
    "term": "insurance policy number",
    "definition": "A structured identifier for an insurance policy, formatted as INS-AA-0000-A."
  },
  "playbook_suggestion": {
    "agent_pair": "intake->claims",
    "action": "tokenize"
  }
}
